rules: All XDR is the Soroban ScVal XDR produced by soroban-sdk `to_xdr`, lowercase hex.

Session ID = sha256(ScVal Vec[Bytes(domain_xdr), Bytes(payload_xdr)]) where domain = Vec[Bytes("lumenbazaar/session-id"), U32(interface_version), Bytes(network_id), Address(contract)] and payload = Vec[Address(buyer), Address(seller), Address(asset), I128(max_amount), U32(expires_at_ledger), Bytes(resource_hash), U64(sequence), Bytes(idempotency_key)].

Usage commitment = sha256(ScVal Vec[Bytes(domain_xdr), Bytes(payload_xdr)]) where domain uses the label "lumenbazaar/usage-commitment" and payload = Vec[U32(receipt_schema_version), Bytes(session_id), I128(actual_amount), Bytes(resource_hash), Bytes(measurement_hash)].

network_id = sha256(UTF-8 bytes of the network passphrase). No Unicode normalization is applied when hashing: NFC and NFD forms of the same visible text produce different network IDs, so producers must reject non-NFC input instead of normalizing it.
Backend passphrase policy: non-empty, NFC, no leading or trailing whitespace, at most 256 UTF-16 code units (JavaScript string length).
measurement_hash = sha256(canonical usage receipt v1 UTF-8 bytes). Non-ASCII characters are emitted as raw UTF-8, never as \u escapes.
Amounts are canonical base-10 strings matching ^(0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$ that fit i128. create_session additionally requires max_amount > 0 (ContractError::InvalidAmount).
Resource hashes are exactly 32 bytes of lowercase hex. The all-zero hash is encodable but rejected by create_session (ContractError::InvalidResourceHash).
Contract-facing addresses are G (account) or C (contract) strkeys. Muxed M addresses are not accepted as Address arguments.
Events use #[contractevent] defaults: topics = [Symbol(snake_case event name), indexed fields...], data = Map of the remaining fields keyed by Symbol in ascending key order.
synthetic: All addresses are repeated-byte synthetic strkeys with no known secret key. The only real network value is the public testnet passphrase.
